_comment: Log of recent decks generated by the slide skill. Used by Step 2 of the workflow to compute negative constraints for the next deck. The skill reads this at start and appends to it at end. Keeps only the last 10 entries. Each entry records the deck's six brief decisions plus the layout sequence so the next deck can avoid repetition.

_schema.topic_slug: kebab-case identifier of the deck topic
_schema.date: ISO date the deck was generated
_schema.chrome: one of: editorial-rail | minimal-rail | archival | peripheral-data | invisible | instrumental
_schema.grid: one of the 8 grids from art-direction.md
_schema.geometry: one of: circle | triangle | arc | block | sunburst | waveform | grid | none
_schema.opening_layout: the layout primitive used in slide 1
_schema.sequence: array of layout primitives in order
